setting.description: A delta town whose floods have been growing worse each year.

visible.role: The newly appointed keeper of the town's flood records.

attractors: The participant needs a way to reason about quantities that grow in proportion to themselves before anyone names it.
invariants: No one explains the concept in advance.
Linear and intuitive forecasts fail visibly, with consequences.
The idea is named only after the participant has struggled toward it, if it is named at all.
